name: SS - Upsell Carousel
description: Sleek horizontal upsell carousel featuring multiple product recommendations in glassmorphism-styled cards with smooth snap scrolling. Each card displays a product image with subtle zoom on hover, vendor tag, title, price with savings indicator, and an elegant CTA button. Includes navigation arrows, dot indicators, a progress bar, and optional autoplay. The section header supports eyebrow text, heading, and subtext. Configurable card width, image ratio, carousel behavior, typography, colors, and spacing. Perfect for frequently bought together, you may also like, and recommended products sections.
author: Section Hub
